name: rb-nestjs
comment: Its own package and lockfile, never a workspace of the repository's, so the versions /__meta reports are the ones this lockfile resolved. Nest's classes are written with decorators, which Node's type stripping does not run, so nest build compiles the source into dist/, and the hosts run that. typescript stays at 6, because the Nest CLI compiles through TypeScript's JavaScript API, which TypeScript 7 does not have. client builds a second time into dist/client/ with @nestjs/swagger's CLI plugin, writes Client/openapi.json from that build, and generates the Kiota client. generate.ts passes --experimental-strip-types because Node 22 needs it. Node 26, which the image runs, accepts it.

scripts.client: nest build -c nest-cli.client.json && node dist/client/Client/document.js && node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning Client/generate.ts
